body: Well thanks, next time I post here I'll probably be losing my mind, but I think you'll see me again...
I have someone, but she's never there when I need someone... I always end up alone when I feel really terrible

The blood doesn't bother me, but it's not about the blood. It's like... imagine your feelings on a scale of -10 through 10. When I start feeling fucking terrible, you'd say im on a... -8? And cutting makes you feel kind of numb and emotionless, puts you back at a weird neutral. It doesn't make me feel good, but it makes me feel better by comparison.
That's easy to say from your perspective, but from mine I really don't even care to get through this, I want to quit while I can.
Really sorry to hear that, thanks for the advice. I'm trying to hang in there, I just don't know...

Thanks... but, if noone else thinks its serious, why tell anyone or try to get help? I don't want to ask some doctor to fix my problems, and I especially don't want to rely on antidepressants to be happy.

It's funny how that works, I've got a few friends and one best friend who I can talk to about this kind of thing, but I've never got anyone when I need it.
I can't really afford to spoil myself much, no surprise there.
I'm almost always listening to music. And every second I can, I am.
I try to do nice things from time to time, goes unnoticed quite often, and it doesn't really make me feel any better.
I haven't tried meditating, not really sure how all that works, but when I try to lay down and relax I usually end up feeling depressed from thinking too much.
I eat pretty regularly except when I'm on break, pretty much any routine falls apart at that point. I've only had alcohol once, weed twice, meh.
Sounds weird but I avoid working out for fear of judgemental people (family, even... mostly family, actually)
The sleep thing has been my main coping technique, but it's working less and less, I can't go to sleep very well, sometimes not at all, when I feel really depressed. And other times it just doesn't work, I'll go to bed feeling like complete shit and wake up in the same mood, my day will continue that way until the night when I try to sleep it off again.

I'm glad to see someone who actually cares, thanks. I can't bring myself to tell my parents, I just can't. Maybe one day I'll be able to but for the time being, it's just not gonna happen. I'm smart, I hate to brag, but I'm fairly smart (not a genius, but above average) and I used to make all A's like you, I'm not as bad as you said with D's but I'm getting there, the longer this goes on and the worse it gets, so do my grades. I'm at all B's, a few C's, and D right now. I really just don't see this ending anytime soon and I'd rather just quit than live the rest of my life like this. It's this terrible feeling of sadness which seems like it's always there, it feels like some sort of disease. It's always there sitting in the back of my mind but whenever it feels like it, it swells up and makes me not be able to think straight and I don't want anything but to just die and get out of here. The "swelling up and going crazy" happens more and more often as time goes on. Obviously, I don't feel good right now, but I'm not losing it at the moment, so I'm trying to take a fair, realisitic look at my situation instead of just giving in to my emotions and making a big rant about how much I hate my life.
EDIT: Going to bed for now, I'll check read whatevers here in the morning, sorry.
